## Original Source

```json
// .vscode/tasks.json
// Thank you @KevM
{
    "version": "2.0.0",
    "tasks": [
        {
            "label": "Run dbn-go-tui with headless dlv",
            "type": "process",
            "command": [
                "dlv",
            ],
            "args": [
                "debug",
                "--headless",
                "--listen=:2345",
                "--api-version=2",
                "${workspaceFolder}/cmd/dbn-go-tui", "--",
                "--key", "<insert-api-key>"
            ],
            "isBackground": true,
            "problemMatcher": {
                "owner": "go",
                "fileLocation": "relative",
                "pattern": {
                    "regexp": "^couldn't start listener:", // error if matched
                },
                "background": {
                    "activeOnStart": true,
                    "beginsPattern": "^API server listening at:",
                    "endsPattern": "^Got a connection, launched process" // success if matched
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}

```
